question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **BIBLIOPHILE**
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. Book-lover .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bibliophile"** refers to a person who has a great love or fondness for books.
 
• Among the given options, option 4, **"Book-lover"**, is the most appropriate synonym for the word "Bibliophile".
 
• Other options like **Publisher**, **Bookkeeper**, or **Librarian** refer to professions or roles related to books but do not convey the sense of having a deep love for books.

Correct meaning: *A bibliophile is someone who loves and collects books.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bibliophile Origin:**
 
 
• **Root Words:** Derived from the Greek words "biblion" (book) and "philos" (loving).
 
• **Meaning:** A person with a passionate interest in books, often collecting rare or special editions.
 
 
 
• **Examples of Usage:**
 
 
• John is a true bibliophile; his library is filled with rare books from around the world.
 
• As a bibliophile, Maria spends most of her weekends exploring second-hand bookstores.
